_example._comment: WORKED EXAMPLE — not an active claim. If registered as a claim, the gate CERTIFIES it (exit 0): rounds 1-3 are ELIGIBLE with inadequate service (debt 3); rounds 4-5 are UNDETERMINED (scheduler log segments MISSING) with inadequate service known; round 6 is ELIGIBLE with adequate service (reset to 0); rounds 7-8 are UNDETERMINED (STALE). Engine: [3,3] -> hull [3,5] -> reset [0,0] -> hull [0,2]. Bound 3: debt_max 2 <= 3 -> NO_BREACH. The claim asserts NO_BREACH: honest, certified. Flip asserted_conclusion to BREACH and the gate BLOCKS it (false breach). This is the window D59 cannot assess (2^5 histories is fine here, but the same shape at 20 unresolved rounds exceeds D59's 2^12 cap while D60 bounds it exactly in O(N)).

defects.detail: scheduler log segment for round 4 absent — re-fetch scheduled
scheduler log segment for round 5 absent — re-fetch scheduled
ordering log for round 7 older than validity window
ordering log for round 8 older than validity window

_note: Debt-bound claims judged by tools/d60_fairness_debt_bounds_gate.py against the REAL D60 engine (drift_canary/fairness_debt_bounds.py, PR #2315). Empty 'claims' = explicit DORMANT (never a false green). The first claim merged activates enforcement with zero new wiring. Claims are evidence declarations: the gate rebuilds the rounds and the BOUNDED contract from the declared evidence and runs the engine — a claim the engine refuses or disagrees with is BLOCKED (exit 1); an untrustworthy manifest is BROKEN (exit 2). D60's distinctive coverage: windows with many unresolved rounds that exceed D59's 2^12 enumeration cap are bounded exactly here in O(N).

_schema.asserted_conclusion: BREACH | NO_BREACH | UNRESOLVED — what the team claims the engine finds
_schema.bound: positive integer — the BOUNDED fairness contract's service_bound_rounds
_schema.capacity_basis: non-empty string — what the bound was derived from (never an arbitrary timeout)
_schema.evidence_ref: link to the evidence (board comment, run log, check run)
_schema.rounds: non-empty list of {round_seq (int), verdict: eligible|ineligible|undetermined, adequate_service (bool — must be a known bool), defects: [{component (one of the six D58 components), kind: MISSING|CONTRADICTORY|STALE|UNVERIFIABLE, detail (non-empty)}] — UNDETERMINED rounds must carry defects; settled verdicts carry none}
